scope: Proposition 2.5 of the manuscript “The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global function fields” (preprints/The-Margulis-Platonov-conjecture-over-global-function-fields-October-5-2026/margulis-platonov-global-function-fields.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 018 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7e90f88648f7bafc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let F be a global function field and H a simply connected absolutely almost simple F-group for which the Margulis–Platonov assertion holds. Put AH = {w : rankFw H = 0}. Every homomorphism ψ : H(F) → Q to a finite group extends uniquely to a continuous homomorphism b ψ : Y w∈AH H(Fw) −→ Q with the same image. In particular, ψ kills every rational point whose coordinates at AH are sufficiently close to the identity. If AH = ∅, every such ψ is trivial. The same conclusions hold factor by factor for finite products of restriction-of-scalars groups.
